0c88dacffc4c6f8d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المنطقة الأمنه لاجهزة السلامة عن فني حساب كميات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية حصر كميات وتسعير مشاريع أنظمة السلامة ومكافحة الحريق والإنذار، بالإضافة إلى إعداد العروض الفنية والمالية. يجب أن تتوافق هذه العروض مع مخططات المشروع والمواصفات والكود السعودي للحماية من الحرائق ومتطلبات الدفاع المدني. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة المخططات والمواصفات وجداول الكميات ووثائق المناقصات بدقة. حصر كميات أنظمة إنذار الحريق، مكافحة الحريق، الرش الآلي، الهوز ريل، الشبكات، المضخات، الخزانات، أنظمة الغاز، وأنظمة الإخلاء الصوتي والطوارئ. إعداد قوائم الكميات (BOQ) والتأكد من مطابقة البنود للمخططات ومتطلبات المشروع. طلب عروض الأسعار من الموردين والمقاولين الباطن ومقارنتها وتحليلها. إعداد التكلفة التقديرية للمشاريع، بما يشمل المواد، العمالة، المعدات، التركيب، الاختبارات، المصاريف غير المباشرة وهامش الربح. إعداد عروض الأسعار الفنية والمالية ومراجعتها قبل تقديمها للعميل. التنسيق مع قسم المشاريع والفريق الفني لضمان واقعية الأسعار وقابلية التنفيذ. إعداد وتحليل أوامر التغيير والأعمال الإضافية والمطالبات المالية عند الحاجة. تحديث قاعدة بيانات الأسعار والموردين وتكاليف التنفيذ بشكل مستمر. دعم فريق المبيعات في الاستفسارات الفنية والتجارية للمناقصات والعملاء. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال حساب الكميات وتسعير مشاريع أنظمة السلامة ومكافحة الحريق. فهم عميق لمخططات المشاريع والمواصفات الفنية. معرفة بالكود السعودي للحماية من الحرائق ومتطلبات الدفاع المدني. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة دوام كامل ويقع في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل فني حساب الكميات ضمن فريق متخصص لدعم مشاريع الشركة في مجال أنظمة السلامة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

0c89c9aee190379f.description: عن كارديال كارديال علامة سعودية منذ عام 1983، متخصصة في الساعات والمجوهرات والعطور والإكسسوارات، ولها أكثر من 160 فرعاً في المملكة إضافة إلى متجرها الإلكتروني. الهدف من الوظيفة نبحث عن كفاءات شغوفة بالبيع وتملك مهارة الإقناع، لتقديم تجربة شراء مميزة للعملاء في الفرع وتحقيق المستهدفات البيعية الشهرية لمنتجات العطور والساعات. المهام والمسؤوليات استقبال العملاء والتعرّف على احتياجاتهم وتقديم التوصية المناسبة من العطور والساعات. تحقيق التارقت البيعي الشهري للفرد وللفرع أو تجاوزه. عرض مزايا المنتجات بأسلوب مقنع واحترافي، وتطبيق أساليب البيع الإضافي (Up-selling) والبيع المتقاطع (Cross-selling). بناء علاقات طويلة مع العملاء وتشجيعهم على العودة للشراء. الحفاظ على ترتيب منطقة العرض ونظافتها حسب معايير العرض في كارديال. إتمام عمليات البيع على نظام نقاط البيع (POS) بدقة. التعامل مع استفسارات العملاء وملاحظاتهم بمهنية. المتطلبات خبرة لا تقل عن سنة في مبيعات التجزئة، ويُفضَّل أن تكون في العطور أو الساعات أو المنتجات الفاخرة. مهارات عالية في الإقناع والتواصل والتعامل مع العملاء. حضور ومظهر احترافي. المهارات المطلوبة الإقناع والتفاوض. التركيز على النتائج وتحقيق الأهداف. الاهتمام بتجربة العميل. العمل ضمن فريق. المعرفة بأنواع العطور وفئات الساعات ميزة إضافية.

0cb03a911030c3d2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مدي نوبا الطبي عن أخصائي مختبرات طبية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على تحديد احتياجات المختبر من المواد الأولية، استلام العينات، وإجراء التحاليل والفحوصات المخبرية اللازمة، بالإضافة إلى إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية وحفظها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحديد احتياجات المختبر من المواد الطبية الأولية اللازمة للفحوصات، وتوفيرها، وتسجيلها، والتأكد من سلامتها وتعقيمها، ومراقبة فترة صلاحيتها. استلام عينات الفحص من المرضى وحفظها بالطرق السليمة، وإجراء التحاليل الكيميائية والفيزيائية والمجهرية لتحديد وجود السكر أو البروتين أو الجراثيم والطفيليات. دراسة نتائج الاختبارات المخبرية وإعداد التقارير المفصلة بشأن هذه النتائج. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل المخبري ومواكبة التطورات الحديثة في أساليب التحاليل الطبية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالتحاليل الطبية للمرضى وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها، وذلك وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال المختبرات الطبية للحفاظ على بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المختبرات الطبية. القدرة على تحديد احتياجات المختبر من المواد الأولية وإدارتها. مهارة في استلام العينات وإجراء التحاليل المخبرية بدقة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق الطبية وحفظها. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي المختبرات الطبية بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة مدي نوبا الطبي في مدينة الرياض. تتطلب الوظيفة الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة في بيئة المختبر. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل الموقع: الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية الراتب: غير معلن التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

0cb13eaf6ef701f0.job_title: Murex FO Business Analyst Functional Migration
0cb13eaf6ef701f0.description: About the Role Luxoft is seeking a Murex FO Business Analyst - Functional Migration to join a large bank in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is crucial for a Murex greenfield implementation project, focusing on the functional migration of Front Office systems. The ideal candidate will possess 5-10 years of experience, with a significant portion dedicated to migration projects within the Murex environment. Project Context This position supports a Murex greenfield implementation, specifically addressing the functional migration of Front Office systems. The role involves bridging the gap between technical data migration teams and various business stakeholders, including Front, Middle, and Back Office, to ensure a seamless transition to the Murex * platform. Key Responsibilities Bridge communication between technical data migration teams and business stakeholders (Front, Middle, and Back Office) to facilitate the transition of trading, pricing, and risk systems to the Murex * platform. Collaborate closely with technical teams to ensure accurate migration and validation of trade capture, pricing, and market risk functionalities. Apply extensive Murex workflow experience covering trade life cycle, system interface workflow creation, confirmation generation, error management, and OSP. Support data migration activities, including trade migration, static data migration, reconciliation of legacy versus Murex positions, and trade mapping. Propose enhancements to existing solutions leveraging analytical and technical expertise. Coordinate cutover planning, go-live activities, and provide post-go-live support. Ensure collaboration with other Murex internal, client, and change teams for information sharing. Required Qualifications and Experience 7 to 10 years of overall working experience, with at least 4 years dedicated to migration projects. Proven experience in Murex Treasury migration projects. Solid understanding of various financial products, including IRD, FXD, bonds, repos, commodities, and equities. Strong hands-on functional experience with Murex *, specifically its Front Office modules (Trade Capture, Pricing, Market Data, Pre-Deal/Post-Deal workflows). Experience in at least one full-cycle Murex implementation or migration project. Familiarity with data migration and reconciliation methodologies. Demonstrated knowledge of Murex , MXML, Datamart reporting, and GOM (Global Organization Model). Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, where the successful candidate will work within a large bank environment, contributing to a significant Murex implementation project. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this role at Luxoft.

0cc441aaba7aab0b.description: About the Role stc is seeking a Pre Sales and Bidding Expert to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for leading and supporting pre-sales and bidding activities within the Business-Critical segment, focusing on solution design, proposal development, and bid management. The role involves analyzing customer requirements, developing technically and commercially sound proposals, and coordinating with various stakeholders to ensure successful bid submissions and improved win rates. Key Responsibilities Identify and support the qualification of new business opportunities with enterprise and government clients in the Business-Critical segment. Develop a strong understanding of ICT solutions (infrastructure, IT, and digital services) to effectively address client requirements. Analyze RFPs/RFQs from both technical and commercial perspectives to define appropriate solution approaches. Prepare and deliver high-quality proposals, presentations, and solution documents aligned with customer needs and value propositions. Lead the development of end-to-end technical and commercial proposals, including solution architecture, specifications, and Bills of Quantities (BoQs). Provide technical and commercial inputs to bids in coordination with Business Operations and relevant stakeholders. Coordinate with Technology, Sales, and Product teams to ensure the feasibility and alignment of proposed solutions with client requirements. Identify and mitigate risks within the pre-sales and bidding lifecycle to support successful deal closure. Evaluate bid opportunities and contribute to go/no-go decisions based on defined assessment criteria. Support the development and improvement of bidding strategies, templates, and proposal frameworks. Coordinate cross-functional inputs (Sales, Customer Care, Technology, Legal, Regulatory) to ensure alignment of proposals from technical, commercial, and compliance perspectives. Participate in vendor evaluation and selection processes to support bid requirements. Ensure alignment of proposal timelines with internal approvals and customer deadlines. Maintain and update bid documentation, templates, and proposal repositories to improve efficiency. Analyze win/loss outcomes and support continuous improvement of bidding strategies and success rates. Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to develop integrated, end-to-end solutions in coordination with relevant business units. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this role should possess 3-5 years of relevant experience in pre-sales and bidding activities, particularly within the Business-Critical segment. A strong understanding of ICT solutions, including infrastructure, IT, and digital services, is essential. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within stc's specialized business unit. The role requires collaboration with various internal and external stakeholders to achieve business objectives.

0c1d37603547dc11.description: مطلوب مندوب مبيعات (Pet Food) 🐾 شركة رائدة في مجال أغذية الحيوانات الأليفة تعلن عن حاجتها لتعيين مندوبي مبيعات ميدانيين للعمل في مدينة الرياض. المهام الوظيفية: زيارة العملاء وتطوير المبيعات. فتح عملاء جدد وزيادة التغطية السوقية. متابعة التحصيلات وتنفيذ الخطط البيعية. بناء علاقات قوية مع محلات الحيوانات الأليفة والقطاعات المستهدفة. الشروط: خبرة في المبيعات الميدانية (يفضل في قطاع الأغذية أو المنتجات الاستهلاكية أو الحيوانات الأليفة). امتلاك رخصة قيادة سارية. مهارات تواصل وتفاوض ممتازة. القدرة على تحقيق الأهداف البيعية والعمل الميداني. المزايا: ✅ راتب ثابت مجزٍ ✅ عمولات وحوافز شهرية مرتبطة بالأداء ✅ تأمين طبي ✅ فرص للتطور الوظيفي

0c52c8b1afd87215.description: About the Role The Luxury Collection is seeking an HVAC Technician to join their team in Ad Diriyah, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves the inspection, repair, and maintenance of HVAC, air quality control, and refrigeration equipment, ensuring optimal operational efficiency and guest comfort within the property. Key Responsibilities Inspect, repair, and maintain HVAC, air quality control, and refrigeration equipment. Conduct daily inspections and maintenance of the mechanical plant. Monitor and control property temperature to ensure comfort. Monitor and analyze energy and utilities usage for efficiency. Calibrate all controls, gauges, meters, and other relevant equipment. Assemble, install, test, repair, and maintain electrical systems or electronic wiring. Assemble, install, and maintain pipe assemblies, fittings, and valves. Perform routine pool and spa maintenance. Operational Standards and Safety Adhere to all company and safety and security policies and procedures. Report maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries promptly. Complete all required safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Guest and Team Interaction Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards. Anticipate and address guests’ service needs professionally. Communicate with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues. Listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Qualifications and Physical Requirements 2-5 years of experience in a relevant technical role. Ability to reach overhead and below the knees. Capable of moving in confined or elevated spaces. Ability to move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces. Comfortable moving up and down stairs, service ramps, and/or ladders. Proficiency in grasping, turning, and manipulating objects of varying size and weight. Ability to assist with moving, lifting, carrying, and placing objects weighing in excess of 100 pounds. Capable of moving, lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, and placing objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Additional Duties The HVAC Technician will also ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards, identify, recommend, develop, and implement new ways to increase organizational efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and/or cost-savings. Other reasonable job duties may be requested by Supervisors as needed.

0c72635f626253fd.description: About the Role: Vice Principal Pastoral أعناب is seeking a Vice Principal Pastoral to join an international school in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves leading student wellbeing, safeguarding, behaviour, and pastoral care for upper primary and secondary students. The Vice Principal Pastoral will report directly to the Principal and oversee the daily management of students and a diverse pastoral team. Role Context and Collaboration The successful candidate will work closely with the Vice Principal Academics, heads of department, and teachers. This collaboration is essential to maintain high academic and behavioural standards and to ensure that students receive the necessary support to succeed. The position requires a professional with over 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Lead, implement, and regularly review the school's pastoral care, safeguarding, behaviour, and anti-bullying policies and procedures. Monitor student attendance, punctuality, behaviour, wellbeing, and academic progress. Coordinate timely interventions for students requiring additional support or at risk of exclusion. Oversee individual behaviour and pastoral support plans, assess their impact, and collaborate with academic and learning support teams to remove barriers to learning. Serve as a primary point of contact for students, parents, and staff regarding pastoral matters, and liaise with external agencies as appropriate. Oversee the investigation, documentation, and reporting of student incidents in accordance with school policies and relevant Ministry of Education procedures. Develop staff practice in pastoral care, manage pastoral resources, and support student transitions, leadership opportunities, and enrichment activities. Foster a safe, inclusive, and respectful school culture that aligns with the school's vision and Islamic ethos. Experience and Location Candidates should possess over 10 years of experience in a related educational leadership role. This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Further details regarding the salary for this position will be disclosed during the application process.

0c995f2191a885e5.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع العناية المتميزة الطبي عن طبيب أسنان عام للانضمام إلى فريقه في تبوك. يركز هذا الدور على تشخيص وعلاج أمراض الفم والأسنان، وتقديم رعاية شاملة للمرضى. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة ويعمل بنظام الدوام الكامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الفحص الشامل لأسنان المريض وتحديد الصور الشعاعية اللازمة وتحليلها. تشخيص الحالات المرضية للفم والأسنان وإعداد خطة العلاج والبرنامج الزمني المناسب. تجهيز وتطبيق الحشوات ومعالجة القنوات اللبية للأسنان. تنظيف الأسنان وإزالة الرواسب الكلسية. تحديد احتياجات المريض من التعويضات السنية، وأخذ القياسات، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتركيبها وضبطها. فحص اللثة وتشخيص أمراضها ومعالجة التهابات اللثة. إجراء جراحات الفم الصغرى ووصف العلاجات والأدوية الضرورية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات الحديثة في مجال طب الأسنان. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بطب الأسنان وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال طب وصحة الأسنان. المؤهلات والخبرات درجة البكالوريوس في طب الأسنان أو ما يعادلها. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال طب الأسنان العام. القدرة على تشخيص أمراض الفم والأسنان بدقة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل مع المرضى وتقديم الرعاية اللازمة. بيئة العمل يعمل طبيب الأسنان العام ضمن فريق طبي في مجمع العناية المتميزة الطبي بتبوك. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب الالتزام بتقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة للمرضى. معلومات إضافية المنطقة: تبوك. نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: غير معلن. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم الشروط للتقديم على هذا الدور في مجمع العناية المتميزة الطبي.

0ca34333f32c7d85.description: About the Role Azadea Group is seeking an F&B Quality Control Specialist to join their team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role is essential for maintaining stringent quality standards across all stages of food and beverage handling, from receiving to transportation. The specialist will ensure compliance with established procedures and specifications, contributing to the overall quality assurance framework within the F&B operations. Key Responsibilities Review product expiry dates on a weekly basis, preparing necessary reports and action plans to address any issues. Conduct regular audits and assessments of F&B warehouse conditions, providing comprehensive reports to ensure adherence to established procedures, requirements, and specifications. Research and stay informed about new technologies and resources in the market, offering recommendations for adaptable methods to enhance quality control. Develop and finalize Food Safety and HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) prerequisite documentation, and assist in its implementation. Develop quality control procedures for food production, preservation, and storage, ensuring alignment with established standards. Establish quality control procedures for dispatching and delivering food products between stores or to customers, ensuring strict adherence to established standards and protocols. Define cleaning and maintenance procedures for equipment and outline guidelines for chemical usage within food preparation areas. Conduct visits to assess vendor facilities, verifying compliance with established procedures, requirements, and specifications. Provide technical training to kitchen employees on food safety practices and the proper usage and maintenance of quality control instruments. Prepare corrective action reports for identified quality and safety discrepancies, and monitor the implementation of corrective measures for observed deficiencies. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this role should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in quality control within the food and beverage industry. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of food safety regulations, HACCP principles, and quality assurance best practices. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with responsibilities extending to Jeddah. The role involves regular site visits to warehouses, vendor facilities, and various F&B operational points to ensure consistent quality control across all locations.

0c18b193f703b396.company_name: Qiddiya Investment Company | شركة قدية الاستثمارية
0c18b193f703b396.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Manager - Product Management to assume end-to-end product ownership for critical digital capabilities within Qiddiya’s ecosystem. This full-time role involves close collaboration with a Lead Software Engineer, forming the core product and engineering leadership for the assigned domain. The Senior Manager will ensure that business objectives, customer needs, technical quality, and operational requirements are integrated throughout the product lifecycle. Key Responsibilities Own the product roadmap and priorities for the assigned digital domain. Translate business objectives and customer needs into clear product capabilities, requirements, and measurable outcomes. Partner with the Lead Software Engineer to align product priorities with architecture, technical feasibility, platform health, and engineering capacity. Maintain and prioritize the product backlog based on customer value, business impact, risk, dependencies, and technical considerations. Define business requirements, user journeys, acceptance criteria, success measures, and non-functional expectations. Ensure product capabilities are designed for reuse across Qiddiya’s assets, brands, channels, and customer journeys. Lead discovery activities, including stakeholder workshops, customer research, journey analysis, process mapping, and solution validation. Collaborate with Experience Design, Engineering, Architecture, Data, Operations, Cybersecurity, Commercial, and other business teams. Coordinate dependencies and integration requirements across internal platforms, external partners, and related product domains. Provide product direction and oversight to vendor delivery teams, ensuring alignment with Qiddiya’s priorities and standards. Ensure product decisions, requirements, documentation, and platform knowledge are retained within Qiddiya. Define product KPIs and use data, customer insights, operational feedback, and platform performance to guide prioritization. Monitor adoption, conversion, customer experience, operational performance, and business outcomes post-release. Support incident management by assessing customer and business impact, coordinating stakeholder communication, and prioritizing remediation. Balance the delivery of new capabilities with technical debt, resilience, compliance, operational improvement, and platform sustainability. Maintain clear communication on roadmap progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and expected outcomes. Required Qualifications and Experience 7+ years of product management experience within complex digital, technology, or customer-facing environments. Proven experience owning digital products from discovery through delivery, launch, operation, and continuous improvement. Strong technical understanding of APIs, integrations, digital platforms, data flows, cloud services, and modern software delivery practices. Experience managing products within areas such as commerce, checkout, loyalty, customer accounts, mobile experiences, ticketing, payments, or digital platforms. Strong experience defining product strategies, roadmaps, business requirements, user journeys, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes. Proven ability to work closely with engineering teams and make informed product and technical trade-offs. Experience overseeing vendors, system integrators, or outsourced product and delivery teams. Skills and Competencies Strong analytical skills and experience using product, customer, operational, and commercial data to guide decisions. Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, cross-domain dependencies, and complex delivery environments. Strong communication, facilitation, negotiation, and decision-making skills. Ability to influence teams and stakeholders without relying on direct line-management authority.

0cb2340c3a57dfa5.description: About the Role Acwa China is seeking an HSSE Officer to join their team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time, plant-based position focuses on managing and implementing the HSE management system at the field level, working closely with power or water plant operations. The HSSE Officer will report directly to the HSE Engineer / Plant General Manager/PM and Corporate HSE Manager. Key Responsibilities Coordinate and actively participate in plant activities, ensuring consistency with overall company objectives through HSE management. Conduct toolbox talks, HSE awareness sessions, and on-field HSE meetings with staff and contractors. Lead on-site HSE training programs for field personnel. Improve reporting and recording of unsafe acts/conditions and near misses, and participate in investigations. Coordinate and participate in continuous auditing of HSE management systems. Assist the Administration and Occupational Health Team with post-accident/injury treatment processes. Promote the permit-to-work system and ensure safety for all involved in operations and maintenance. Identify non-compliant, incomplete, or substandard procedures for activities involving employees and/or contractors. Assist field staff and contractors with PPE care, inspection, and compliance. Record and report all incidents, including employee injuries. Support Corporate HSE programs such as People Based Safety, 5S, and Zero Incident processes. Inspect equipment logbooks and records for scaffolding, ladders, cranes, tools, and power tools. Support HSE incentive programs and promotional activities like Safety Day, World Environment Day, or corporate HSE campaigns. Promote HSE Observation and Communication programs involving owner and contractor HSE officers. Inspect portable fire extinguishers, safety eye-wash/shower stations, and maintain their records. Assist the HSE Engineer in risk assessment and maintenance of identified control measures. Offer support to the Incident Controller as part of the emergency response team. Support Corporate Environmental programs including waste management, plantation, and spill control. Support Corporate Occupational Health Programs such as Get Healthy Stay Healthy, Stress Management, and Quit Smoking Programs. Conduct regular walk-around checks to monitor HSE controls. Ensure availability of first aid measures and firefighting equipment at locations, and inspect their status. Collect environmental deviation data and ensure identification and implementation of corrective actions. Coordinate HSE emergency drills and reports. Ensure continuous monitoring of work areas and the presence of controls for identified risks. Provide induction training to new employees, visitors, and contractors/subcontractors. Ensure the availability of medical facilities and medicines in the ambulance. Monitor the validity of equipment certification and operator licenses. Perform other assigned HSE duties as required. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in a similar role. Specific qualifications were not provided, but a background in HSE management systems and plant operations is essential. Work Environment The role involves working near moving mechanical parts and in outdoor weather conditions. The employee may occasionally work in high, precarious places and be exposed to fumes, airborne particles, toxic or chemical risks, and electrical shock. The noise level in the work environment is typically moderate but can be very loud at times.

0cc4b5d9e154d093.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مركز فيزيوثيرا للعلاج الطبيعي عن أخصائي علاج طبيعي للانضمام إلى فريقه في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تقديم خطط علاج طبيعي شاملة ومتابعة تنفيذها للمرضى من الكبار والأطفال، مع ضمان تطبيق أعلى معايير الرعاية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل الحالات المرضية ووضع خطط وبرامج علاج طبيعي مخصصة، ومتابعة تنفيذها بفعالية. تسجيل البيانات العلاجية بدقة وتتبع مدى التقدم الصحي للمريض واستجابته للعلاج. تحديد التمارين والحركات التقويمية اللازمة وتحديد معدلات تكرارها بالتنسيق مع الطبيب المعالج. تدليك المرضى لتحسين أداء عضلات الجسم المصاب وتدريبهم على استخدام الأثقال وبكرات الشد والآلات الرياضية وأجهزة العوارض. تنفيذ الحركات الأرضية لتقوية عضلات الأطراف والظهر والعنق، وتدريب المصاب وذويه على التمارين الواجب متابعتها من المنزل. ضبط وتنظيم الأجهزة المستخدمة في العلاج لضمان سلامتها وفعاليتها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بالعلاج الطبيعي وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال العلاج الطبيعي. العمل مع حالات الكبار وحالات الأطفال. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال العلاج الطبيعي. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل الحالات المرضية بدقة. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتدريب للمرضى وذويهم. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في مركز فيزيوثيرا للعلاج الطبيعي بجدة، مكة المكرمة، ويتطلب العمل المباشر مع المرضى من مختلف الفئات العمرية. تطوير الأداء يتوقع من شاغل الوظيفة تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل باستمرار ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال العلاج الطبيعي لتقديم أفضل رعاية ممكنة.

0cf4ec8219723c04.description: About the Role Astek is seeking a Senior Product/UI Designer to join their team in Makkah or Jeddah. This contract position involves evolving the visual design language across web and mobile products for one of their clients. The role requires translating user needs and research insights into polished, intuitive interfaces, working closely with UX researchers, product managers, and engineers. Key Responsibilities Design high-fidelity, developer-ready web and mobile interfaces in Figma, from wireframes through handoff. Build interactive micro-prototypes to communicate and test interactions, transitions, animations, and component states. Own and evolve the design system, including components, patterns, tokens, documentation, and governance. Translate research, user journeys, and flows into clear, consistent visual designs. Collaborate with product managers and engineers to balance user needs, business goals, and implementation constraints. Participate in agile sprints and present design work in reviews, incorporating feedback and iterating quickly. Use usability testing and stakeholder feedback to improve designs, and clearly explain design rationale. Apply responsive design, accessibility standards, and relevant web and mobile platform guidelines. A portfolio showcasing end-to-end product UI work and the user or business outcomes behind design decisions. Hands-on experience building and maintaining design systems. Experience collaborating in agile, cross-functional product teams and presenting design decisions to varied stakeholders. Experience with ProtoPie, After Effects, or similar motion/prototyping tools; basic knowledge of front-end frameworks is also helpful. Work Type and Location This is a contract position based in the Makkah region, with work opportunities available in Jeddah or Makkah. The salary for this role will be discussed during the interview process.

0cf65bb130641255.description: About the Role Sheraton Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Mechanic to join their team in Medina, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. Conduct checks on oil, fluid levels, tire pressure/wear, charge batteries, and replace spark plugs as needed. Execute preventative maintenance on tools and equipment, including cleaning and lubrication. Maintain proper maintenance inventory and requisition parts and supplies when necessary. Maintain daily logs of operation, maintenance, and safety activities, including test results, instrument readings, and details of equipment malfunctions and maintenance work. 0c78d42741b8e5b4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة السبع سنابل عن أخصائي إدارة خدمات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى دراسة وتحليل وتحديد الخدمات، وإعداد الخطط التطويرية والتشغيلية لتحسين فعاليتها، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بإدارة الخدمات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بإدارة الخدمات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. دراسة التجارب والممارسات في إدارة الخدمات، وتقييم جدوى الاستفادة منها، ورفع التوصيات لتبني أفضل الأساليب. إعداد الخطط التشغيلية للخدمات المختلفة بفعالية، وتحليل العمليات والإجراءات لضمان تكاملها وسلامة مساراتها، وتقديم الخدمات بمعايير عالية من الكفاءة والجودة، ووضع الحلول للتحديات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات التطوير الإداري باستخدام التقنيات الحديثة ومواكبة المستجدات في مجال إدارة الخدمات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في الإشراف على أعمال تشغيل وصيانة الأنظمة الكهربائية وإدارة المرافق. القدرة على أداء المهام الإدارية والفنية المتعلقة بالأعمال الكهربائية في المشاريع. القدرة على إعداد ومراجعة التقارير الدورية والفنية والإدارية الخاصة بأعمال التشغيل والصيانة الكهربائية، ومتابعة تنفيذ المهام وفقاً لخطة العمل. تقديم التدريب والتوجيه الفني لأعضاء فريق العمل لرفع كفاءتهم وتحسين أدائهم في أعمال التشغيل والصيانة الكهربائية. الإلمام التام بأعمال تشغيل وصيانة الأنظمة الكهربائية في المباني الإدارية، بما في ذلك لوحات التوزيع، وشبكات الإنارة والقوى، وأنظمة الطوارئ، ومتابعة الصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية وفقاً للمعايير الفنية. نوع العمل هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقدم لهذا الدور.

0c7dbaaa4e382201.description: About KEO Group KEO Group is a creative enterprise offering end-to-end services in planning, design, and project delivery within the built and natural environments. With over 60 years of experience, KEO has contributed to significant projects globally. The firm is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. World Architecture ranks KEO as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey. The Role KEO Group is seeking a Document Controller to join its Site Supervision team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is critical for establishing, implementing, and managing a robust and auditable document control system throughout the construction and Defects Liability Period of projects. The Document Controller ensures that all project documentation, including technical submissions, correspondence, records, and reports, is properly received, tracked, distributed, archived, and retrieved in accordance with project procedures, service order requirements, and industry best practices, including the use of Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS) such as Aconex. Key Responsibilities Establish and maintain a comprehensive Document Control System for the project duration, including the construction phase and 12-month Defects Liability Period. Implement and manage the use of approved EDMS (*, Aconex or equivalent) for all project documentation. Develop and enforce standard document numbering, filing, and transmittal procedures in line with client and consultant requirements. Receive, log, and distribute all Contractor submissions, including Shop Drawings, Material Approval Requests (MARs), Method Statements, Technical Specifications, Calculations, RFIs, As-Built Drawings, and O&M Manuals. Maintain a live tracker of all submissions with clear status updates (Received, Under Review, Approved, Rejected, Revised). Ensure timely return of reviewed documents with Comment Review Sheets (CRS) and track the open/close status of comments. Control all incoming and outgoing project correspondence, instructions, notices, and reports between the Consultant, Client, Contractor, and other stakeholders. Prepare and issue formal transmittals and maintain accurate records of all communications. Support the team in preparing and compiling Daily, Weekly, and Monthly Reports. Ensure all quality-related documentation (ITPs, MIRs, WIRs, inspection records, test results, NCRs) is properly filed and easily retrievable. Support the compilation of the Project Completion Dossier and Handover Package in accordance with the client's Asset Completion and Handover Procedure. Maintain records for audit, claims, variations, and regulatory compliance purposes. Provide accurate document status updates for Weekly and Monthly Progress Meetings. Prepare document control metrics and reports as required by the Senior Project Manager/Project Director. Archive all project records in a structured, secure, and indexed manner at project close-out. Provide training and guidance to the supervision team on document control procedures and EDMS usage. Coordinate with discipline leads (Construction Managers, Inspectors, HSE) to ensure timely review and response to submissions. Qualifications and Requirements This position is open to KSA Nationals only. Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of relevant Document Control experience on major construction projects. Proven experience with Electronic Document Management System (EDMS) platforms such as Aconex, SharePoint, or equivalent. Strong knowledge of FIDIC contracts and construction project documentation workflows. Required Skills and Competencies Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic is an advantage. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and EDMS software. Ability to work independently and manage high volumes of documentation under pressure. Understanding of construction processes, shop drawings, technical submissions, and quality records. Commitment to confidentiality and data integrity.

0c946414c9ff9dca.description: About the Role Halian is seeking a Senior Data Engineer for a contract position in Al Khobar, Eastern Province. This role is central to a major enterprise cloud data transformation project, focusing on migrating critical Finance and HR reporting workloads from SAP BW on HANA to Google BigQuery. The successful candidate will take ownership of the data engineering layer, ensuring the integrity and performance of data systems. Key Responsibilities Analyze existing SAP BW data flows, including DataSources, DSOs, InfoCubes, transformations, ABAP routines, and APDs, and rebuild the required transformation logic using BigQuery SQL. Ingest and integrate data from SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, and/or SAP BW into Google Cloud-based data platforms. Design scalable BigQuery data models utilizing raw, curated, and reporting layers. Build complex data structures including hierarchies, time-dependent master data, dimensional models, and star schemas. Develop, orchestrate, and monitor data pipelines using Cloud Composer / Apache Airflow, incorporating automated alerting for pipeline and load failures. Implement data security within BigQuery, including row-level security (RLS), column-level security (CLS), authorized views, role-based access, and PII masking. Optimize BigQuery workloads for performance and cost through partitioning, clustering, query optimization, and efficient data modeling. Build automated data-quality controls and reconciliation processes to validate migrated datasets against existing SAP BW reporting. Produce and maintain data lineage, transformation documentation, and source-to-target mappings. Prepare governed AI-ready datasets for conversational analytics, predictive use cases, and downstream AI applications. Support downstream reporting and analytics solutions developed using Looker or custom web applications. Collaborate with business, Finance, HR, SAP, cloud, analytics, and reporting teams to validate business logic and data accuracy. Required Qualifications and Experience 5+ years of professional data engineering experience, with at least 3 years of hands-on Google BigQuery experience. Advanced SQL skills, particularly for complex data transformation and modeling in BigQuery. Strong Python skills for data engineering, automation, testing, and pipeline development. Hands-on experience with dbt or Dataform. Strong experience with GCP data services including BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer, Dataflow, IAM, and VPC networking fundamentals. Proven experience integrating SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, and/or SAP BW data with a cloud data platform. Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, star schemas, layered data architectures, hierarchies, and master data. Experience implementing BigQuery security, including RLS, CLS, authorized views, IAM-based access controls, and data masking. Experience with data-quality frameworks, reconciliation, lineage, and source-to-target mapping. Ability to troubleshoot complex data pipelines and transformation logic across SAP and cloud environments. Project Context This role will also support the creation of high-quality, AI-ready datasets for advanced analytics, conversational analytics, and predictive use cases, contributing to the broader data transformation objectives of the enterprise. Work Type This is a contract position requiring dedicated engagement to meet project milestones and objectives.

0cf61e6422519337.description: Job description About the role We are seeking a Senior Associate to manage end‑to‑end post‑trade custody operations for the Saudi Arabia (KSA) market , covering securities settlement, cash & FX operational support, corporate actions and income, reconciliations, and onboarding/account setup – Sunday to Thursday . This role requires strong familiarity with local market practices and a solid understanding of the KSA post‑trade ecosystem: trading on Saudi Exchange , clearing via Muqassa (CCP) , and depository/settlement via Edaa , with settlement cash movements supported through SAMA . Why this role is important to us State Street is one of the world’s largest global custodians, with over USD 51.7 trillion in AUC/A , and is executing a growth strategy that includes expanding direct market presence. As part of this strategy, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) is a priority market , supported by Vision 2030 reforms , increasing foreign participation, and strong institutional demand. This role is critical to: Enabling scalable market entry and growth by delivering strong, controlled post‑trade operations aligned to local market infrastructure and rules. Ensuring a high-quality client experience through timely settlement, strong exception management, and robust controls as KSA market activity expands. Supporting the firm’s ability to deepen relationships with key institutional clients as the market evolves. Key responsibilities (KSA-specific) 1) Clearing & settlement operations (Cash Market – Equities / ETFs / Sukuk & Bonds as applicable) Manage settlement processing for Saudi Exchange transactions settling at Edaa , ensuring accurate, timely completion across relevant cycles (e.g., T+2 for normal exchange trades; negotiated deals T+0–T+5 ; buy‑ins T+0 , as applicable). Reconcile and validate trade/settlement obligations by aligning client instructions and broker confirmations with clearing outcomes (Muqassa) and settlement processing (Edaa); investigate and resolve exceptions promptly. Monitor settlement status proactively, manage potential fails, and follow KSA fails workflows noting that fails management procedures are defined and conducted by Muqassa , with Edaa rollover/cancellation and market-claim handling where applicable. Manage lifecycle of settlement instructions (including amendments/cancellations/partial settlement where permitted) in line with Edaa procedures and local cut‑offs. 2) Cash settlement & funding (SAMA) Ensure funding readiness for DvP settlement , understanding that KSA settlement is gross on the securities leg and netted on the cash leg , with cash settlement executed via SAMA settlement member accounts. Perform cash reconciliations linked to settlement activity; investigate breaks and drive timely resolution within cut‑offs. 3) FX operations (operational support) Process FX-related operational activities supporting settlement and client cash requirements (settlement-linked and standalone requests per operating model), validating confirmations and ensuring correct value dating and SSI usage. 4) Corporate actions, dividends & income Manage corporate actions and income events, ensuring accurate entitlements, timely postings, and robust reconciliations; coordinate vendor feeds and security setup with internal market data/static data teams as required. 5) Client onboarding & investor identification Support onboarding/account setup and documentation in line with Edaa account structures and membership rules; ensure correct capture/validation of investor identification in Edaa’s framework (Investor Identification Number / Investor ID ). Support QFI onboarding requirements within the local custody/account operating model to ensure settlement readiness. 6) Messaging, controls & stakeholder management Use SWIFT ISO 15022 (MT) and exposure to ISO 20022 (MX) standards for settlement/reconciliation/corporate actions messaging with clients/custodians and market counterparts, supporting high STP and clean exception handling. Execute daily controls and checklists on time; ensure adherence to local cut‑offs and internal policies; escalate high‑risk/time‑sensitive issues with clear impact articulation. Partner with internal teams (Operations, Risk, Client Services) and external stakeholders (brokers, clearing/settlement participants, custodians, relevant market entities) to resolve issues and improve outcomes. Experience & preferred qualifications Bachelor’s degree (or above) in Finance, Accounting, or related field. 3–5 years’ experience in custody/post‑trade operations (KSA market experience strongly preferred). Strong understanding of KSA post‑trade flow across Muqassa (clearing/CCP) and Edaa (CSD/settlement) , and the implications of T+2 and DvP cash settlement via SAMA . Strong analytical/problem-solving skills, attention to detail, ability to work under strict cut-offs, and strong stakeholder management. About State Street Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success. We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future. بالأقسام. متابعة طلبات الصيانة والشراء لجميع الأجهزة وللمركز. تسجيل احتياجات العيادات (عيادة التمريض - عيادة العلاج الطبيعي - عيادة الوظيفي - العيادة النفسية - عيادة النطق والتخاطب - الفصول). متابعة دخول المستفيدين للمركز وتوزيعهم بالفصول وقت المناوبة. الإشراف الدوري على تواجد الأخصائيين مع المستفيدين. الإشراف الدوري على الأقسام وتأمينها للمستفيدين. التأكد من إجراءات السلامة واستكشاف حالات الطوارئ (بما في ذلك نموذج الأمن والسلامة الخاص بالإدارة الفنية). الإشراف الدوري على نظافة وجودة مرافق المركز وتدوين ذلك (المسؤولية الكاملة عن نظافة المركز ومرافقه من فصول وعيادات وغرف طعام وتوزيع أدوات النظافة على طاقم التنظيف بشكل يومي). متابعة ترتيب المستودع وتوزيع العهد على الأخصائيين. متابعات طلبات الشراء وتوفيرها. متابعة قسم الإعلام (إعداد جداول لتصوير المستفيدين وتصوير جلساتهم وجمع الفيديوهات وإرسالها للأهل أسبوعياً). المشاركة بالأنشطة الجماعية والرحلات الخارجية. متابعة طلبات الطباعة وتصوير الأوراق. المشاركة في أعمال الفريق والتعاون معهم. تجميع تحضير الفصول الورقي نهاية كل أسبوع وتسليمه للأخصائي الاجتماعي. الالتزام بالقوانين واللوائح والتعليمات المنظمة للعمل. جرد أصول الفرع والأثاث. متابعة رضا أولياء الأمور عن خدمة النقل. إعداد كشف حضور وغياب الأطفال. متابعة استئذان الأطفال واتباع الإجراءات اللازمة له. إعداد سجل استئذان الأطفال وتوثيقه. متابعة خدمة العاملات للأطفال. متابعة خروج الأطفال للباصات والنقل الخاص. تسجيل أرقام أولياء أمور الأطفال في الجوال الخاص بالمركز – تحديث. إعداد الإحصائية الأسبوعية للخدمات المساندة لكل طفل. إعداد جدول الزيارات الإشرافية لمشرفة البرنامج. استلام ملف الطفل والتأكد من استكمال الأوراق المطلوبة ومتابعة ذلك والتحديث عند الحاجة. تنظيم الأرشيف الخاص بملفات المستفيدين. متابعة السلامة والنظافة والمظهر العام بكامل الدور. تكلف بمهام الإعلام. التعاون عند الضرورة القصوى داخل الفصول مع الأخصائيين. متابعة العاملات في (نظافة القسم + خروج المستفيدين لدورات المياه). المتابعة على نظافة الفصول ومتابعة ترتيبها. المساعدة فترة الوجبة عند الحاجة. مساعدة الأخصائي الاجتماعي باستكمال ملفات المستفيدين. المشاركة بالأنشطة الجماعية الداخلية والخارجية بالمركز. مراعاة سلامة المستفيدين داخل المركز. الاحتفاظ بأدوات النظافة في المكان المخصص لها بعيداً عن المستفيدين. مسؤوليات أخرى: أي مهام يكلف بها من المدير المباشر. الكفاءات والمهارات: المؤهلات العلمية: المؤهل العلمي: شهادة الثانوية. المؤهل المفضل: دبلوم كلية مجتمع (سكرتاريا أو إدارة أعمال أو نظم معلومات إدارية). المهارات الشخصية: القدرة على إدارة الفرق والتوجيه بفعالية. مهارات حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات بسرعة. مهارات تنظيمية قوية وإدارة الوقت. القدرة على العمل تحت الضغط والتعامل مع التحديات الميدانية. الخبرات العملية: يفضل سنة في مجال العمل. المهارات التقنية: إجادة استخدام الحاسب الآلي وبرامج Microsoft Office والتطبيقات التقنية. المهارات التواصلية: مهارات ممتازة في القيادة والتوجيه والتواصل الفعّال.

0c267196806da256.description: Eram Talent is seeking a skilled Greenhouse Field Technician to support greenhouse operations and ensure optimal plant growth in field conditions. The technician will need to independently implement and manage field and greenhouse activities, ranging from research experiments including design of field and greenhouse experiments, development of work plans for field research, maintenance and service of research equipment, manage field research plots and greenhouse plants for successful research and propagation. The candidate must be self-motivated, able to work in a multi-cultural setting and have strong communication skills in English, both oral and written. Responsibilities: Monitor and manage environmental conditions such as temperature, humidity, and soil moisture in greenhouse and field settings. ensure successful propagation of research plants Manage greenhouse operations Assist in planting, transplanting, and maintenance of crops within greenhouse and field environments. Collect needed phenotypic data for successful experiments Organization of greenhouse and field spaces Inspect plants for diseases, pests, and nutrient deficiencies, and recommend corrective actions. Operate and maintain irrigation and fertigation systems to ensure adequate water and nutrient supply. Maintain accurate records of field activities, crop growth stages, and environmental data. Diploma or degree in horticulture, agriculture, plant sciences, or a related field. Prior experience working in greenhouse or agricultural field environments. Knowledge of plant health, pest and disease identification, and soil management. Familiarity with irrigation, fertigation, and greenhouse environmental control systems. Experience with field and greenhouse-based research and/or production agriculture (required) Knowledge of fertilizer and chemical application and management (required); commercial applicator license is preferred Familiarity with precision agriculture tools and technologies (preferred) Experience with plant propagation techniques and crop management Good communication skills and ability to work both independently and in team settings. Commitment to health and safety standards.
